preconditions.text: A user transfer/transferFrom action is executed such that _claimRewards() is invoked atomically through the _update hook.; SiloVault accrues fees from interests (delta totalAssets) via _accrueFee(), which mints additional shares to the fee receiver.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.
evidence: The vulnerability is when _claimRewards() is invoked atomically through hooks (_udpate), the _accrueFee() will be missed in the user's transfer/transferFrom call. In this case, an incorrect totalSupply() will be used for fee accrual, leading to incorrect fee accrual.

SiloVault's totalSupply() [accrueFees](https://github.com/code-423n4/2025-03-silo-finance/blob/0409be5b85d7aabfbbe10de1de1890d4b862d2d5/silo-vaults/contracts/SiloVault.sol#L944) from interests (delta totalAssets). Such fee accrual is updated through _accrueFee() which mints additional share to fee reciever.

safety.text: Before _claimRewards() is invoked, _accrueFee() (or _updateLastTotalAssets(_accrueFee())) should be called so that totalSupply() is synced for fee accrual.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.
evidence: We see that when claiming rewards directly through `claimRewards()` the accrued extra share is updated first before _claimRewards().
In _update() hook, consider adding `_accrueFee()` or `_updateLastTotalAssets(_accrueFee())` before `_claimRewards()`.
